rule: Transfer through GPA is allowed only if the owner lives abroad and cannot come in person
SPA transfer allowed when purchaser is in Pakistan but must leave before transfer, or purchaser is abroad; plot is transferred in actual purchaser's name
Out-station transfer available to any member subject to transfer policy; reduced fee for disabled and senior citizens 65+
exception: Travel, boarding and lodging of team borne by member

rule: Physical presence of seller and purchaser is required for transfer
A separate membership (and fee) is required for every plot and every phase
Serving defence officers and serving DHA employees get 50% membership fee concession; civilian rates if they buy from the market
Payments accepted only by pay order / bank draft / bank deposit; no cash, no cheques, no out-station pay orders
Physical presence of allottee is mandatory to collect allotment certificate / open file
Physical presence of allottee is mandatory for endorsement of allotment certificate
De-amalgamation only after amalgamation; residential plots not divided below 2 kanal, commercial not below 8 marla

Eligible: residents owning residential property in DHA, spouse, children, dependent parents/grandparents, dependent children and daughters-in-law, dependent grandchildren, dependent unmarried sisters, and tenants with dependents
exception: Members owning only a plot (not residing) are NOT eligible

rule: Rent agreement with a female tenant accepted only if no male family member is above 18
Owner is responsible for tenant's compliance; utilities may be discontinued for violations
Vehicle must be registered in the name of the resident or a family member residing in DHA (leased vehicles need authority letter)
Vehicle must be registered in applicant's name; no cargo vehicles; tag not reissued if expired/damaged tag not returned
Only serving or retired officers of Army, Air Force, Navy, CAF who are not DHA residents
CCTV recording cannot be used as evidence in court or in print media; handed over via Security Office representative; applicant provides USB
Solar panels must be installed by a DHAI-R registered solar firm with 3D design, site visit and BC approval; stability certificate mandatory
Contractor registration with security clearance is mandatory before construction of any residential building
Drawings must be prepared by DHAI-R registered architect and structure engineer
No excavation / demarcation for new construction during monsoon (15 Jul - 15 Sep)
Houses with religious / sectarian / political flags (other than national flag) will not be cleared for completion
Architect: M.Arch, or B.Arch from top-10 Pakistani university; PCATP registration; min 5 years experience
MEP engineer: BSc/MSc Mechanical/Electrical; PEC or equivalent registration; 15 years experience
Vetting engineer: MSc Structure; PEC registration as consultant
Soil test lab: at least 1 Geologist/Geotech engineer (MSc) with 5 years experience; PEC registration as soil investigation firm
Solar firm: established office; PEC registered; income & sales tax registered; 3 years in business; ~20 installations in 3 years; NEPRA & AEDB certificates
Structure engineer criteria (see form)
Car sticker: vehicle used by family; must be removed and returned on sale/expiry
Dogs must be registered with DHA; dangerous dogs out only at prescribed timings and on leash
